name: API Tap Water Conditioner
description: Highly-concentrated dechlorinator that neutralises chlorine and breaks the chloramine bond. A husbandry safety additive, not a fertiliser — no nutrient `contributes`.
notes: Very concentrated — label dose ~1 ml per ~240 L (1 ml treats ~60 US gal). Does not detoxify ammonia the way Prime does; pure dechlorinator.
